idea: Count to 10 at THE SUPERMARKET with Baby Jimmy (HOME/OUTDOOR t-shirt). A single orange rolls up to him on a wooden produce shelf ('Wow! One little orange!'), then more oranges appear so he counts a clear row of FIVE ('One, two, three, four, five!'), then a tidy tray of TEN (two rows of five) that he claps for ('Six, seven, eight, nine, ten!'). He asks the viewer 'How many oranges? Hmm?' (2 s pause), answers 'Ten!', recounts for fun, then waves 'Bye bye, friends!'. Loop: back to the one orange beside his face.
lesson: Count from 1 to 10 in order; ten is five and five together.
calendar: Monday slot 1 (NY 06:07, before 07:00) = Numbers & counting (1-10 in order). Series continues from count-to-5 (20 Nov pumpkins / 2 Nov tower) to count-to-10 - next step in the number series. Distinct from the 20 Nov count-to-5 long video: higher number, different fruit (oranges), different place (supermarket), 2x5 structure.

variety.outfit: OUTDOOR (light blue star t-shirt, navy shorts, white/yellow sneakers)

characters: BABY JIMMY: a cute chubby 1-year-old baby boy with fluffy curly ginger hair, big blue eyes, light freckles, rosy cheeks. wearing a light blue t-shirt with a small yellow star, navy blue shorts and white sneakers with yellow laces.
setting: SUPPORTING OBJECTS: ORANGES = plain round bright orange oranges, smooth skin, no leaves/stickers/labels, all the same size and pure orange color, arranged in clear rows easy to count.

shots.frame: f1 - one orange rolling up beside his face, big gasp, hands on cheeks
f2 - five oranges in one neat row, Jimmy pointing and counting
f3 - TEN oranges in a tidy 2x5 grid, Jimmy clapping
f4 - curious face, finger on chin, 'How many? Hmm?'
f5 - edit of f1, one orange beside the face, bye-bye wave

learning.shown_how: One orange (hook), a clear row of five (1-5), a tidy tray of ten as two rows of five (6-10 and the answer); counts on screen match the number sung.
learning.song_repeats: numbers one-ten sung in order at 0:03-0:13, 'ten little oranges' 0:13 & 0:20, full 1-10 recount 0:23-0:27 (ten named 4+ times)
learning.interactive_moment: 0:16-0:18 'How many oranges? Hmm?' + 0:18-0:20 humming pause (question boing) -> 0:20 'Ten! Ten little oranges! Yay!' + cheer + confetti
learning.copy_me: Clap with me! (clap on 'ten little oranges, clap with me')
learning.fact_check: Verified at full resolution: hook = exactly 1 orange; count row = exactly 5; review tray = exactly 10 (two rows of five, counted in a cropped close-up); loop = exactly 1. f3 regenerated 3x until exactly ten rendered as a clean 2x5 grid (loose single rows gave nine).
learning.modeling: Gentle, happy play with fruit in a supermarket; nothing unsafe.
learning.toddler_fit: Simple number words, bright calm supermarket, one baby, big face, nothing scary; story order 1->5->10 and loop back.

story_order.oranges: 1 (hook) -> 5 (count) -> 10 (review/answer) -> 1 (loop); each count appears only from its own shot on

song.take: take 1, Gemini flash instrument check clean (no instruments, voices+claps+handdrum only), pause 0:18-0:20 confirmed in transcript
